LESSON: EXTERNAL BODY PARTS. • HEAD, • HANDS • LEGS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Myself
Topic 1.2: External Body Parts. • head, • hands • legs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers External Body Parts. • head, • hands • legs, part of Myself in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do the parts of your body look like?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on External Body Parts. • head, • hands • legs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: learner manipulates digital devices to watch videos of external body parts while observing safety.

11

Values:
• Unity: learner enhances fairness when taking turns in playing games on external body parts.

• Respect: learner enhances respect to self and others when singing songs on external body parts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Developmental perspectives: learner develops self- awareness when naming external body parts of self.

Link to other learning area:

The learner is able to relate the concept of hand when creating images using finger painting technique in Creative Activities.
